B. Gemini concept  look only, text is unreliable

Generated with Gemini 3 Pro Image from the same brief, fed the real gym photo and the real logo. It nails the composition and reproduces the logo, but it cannot be trusted with words: this render says "TRANER" and "100KI". It is also 9:16, because that is the tallest ratio the model offers, where a pull-up banner is 1:2.44. Useful for the look, useless as artwork.
